description.value: You release the potential in a card as pure force, intent on throwing an enemy to the ground. You Play a card against a creature within 30 feet of you and attempt a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} check against them from this range. Your multi-attack penalty applies and increases for this check as normal. If you Play a card of the Strength or Intelligence suits, you ignore your multi attack penalty for your attempt. If you Play a card of the Wisdom suit, you treat this attempt as if you had the maximum multi-attack penalty. You can use your Arcana or Occultism modifier for this attempt if it is higher than your Athletics. If you critically fail, instead of being knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} you @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.arhOfryj6gDtqwZO]{Effect: Bust!} instead.
